paragraphs.en: Leon Werth, as a young boy, faced his first significant challenge. His father, a strict man, forbade him from playing in the park after dark. This rule created tension between them.
paragraphs.zh: 莱昂·韦尔特还是个孩子的时候，就遇到了他人生中的第一个重大挑战。他的父亲是个严厉的人，严禁他在晚上到公园玩耍。这条禁令让他们之间产生了不小的矛盾。

paragraphs.en: Despite the prohibition, Leon often sneaked out to play, leading to an argument one evening when he was caught by his father returning home late.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管禁止外出玩乐，莱昂还是经常偷偷溜出去，有一次晚上被父亲发现回家晚了，两人因此起了争执。
